Tej Pratap Yadav Detained, Sent to Jail Amid Bihar Bandh Protests

Tej Pratap Yadav, a leader of the Janashakti Janta Dal and son of Lalu Prasad Yadav, was detained by Patna police during a Bihar Bandh protest. The protests, which included clashes and stone-pelting in some areas, were related to issues including the NEET paper leak and student issues. Yadav was taken into custody and later sent to jail by a court on charges including rioting and inciting unrest. The exact sequence and reasons for his multiple detentions and eventual jailing were reported by various outlets.
